messages:
carl_infra: FYI monitoring -> ECC rate jump on host gpu-12 (S/N NV-9X23). Auto-drain kicked at 2026-03-15T08:12Z. I opened vendor ticket 34892. Please confirm spare allocation.

jess_ops: On it. How many slots does this take for capacity planning?

carl_infra: It's a single GPU node (4x A100), but node-level drain reduces capacity by 4 gpus. Expect ~15% throughput dip in eu-west until swap.

nina_hw: Vendor replied, courier hold flagged due to customs mismatch. They need depot manifest number and photos. I've attached in ticket.

vendorbot: Ticket 34892 update: "Pending courier clearance. Needs serial confirmation and receipt photo." Link: https://vendor.example.com/t/34892

ops-oncall: Can we do a local spare swap instead of depot? What's the spare pool in eu-west?

maria_sre: We have 3 hot spares in eu-west. If we allocate 1, autoscaler will backfill from dedicated pool in ~12m. Cost delta ~+$0.6/hr per GPU. Want me to claim one?

jess_ops: Yes claim it. Also request transfer manifest: MF-20260315-77. Nina - can you prep photos + RMA label? Put them in the ticket.

nina_hw: Will do. Quick inventory check:
```
fleetctl query --serial NV-9X23 --fields host,node,health,logs
# returns Xid errors: 71, 63; ECC correctable spike 1.2k/24h
```

carl_infra: Thanks. Note: vendor insists original serial on return label. If depot swaps serials we fail audit. @nina_hw please verify serial etching.

nina_hw: Confirmed etching clear. I'll mark custody chain and timestamped photo set. Also requesting courier waiver for manifest mismatch; adding customs invoice number INV-882.

vendorbot: Update: Courier granted temporary hold release if we provide invoice + signed custody. ETA for pickup window: 48-72h. :package:

ops-oncall: Plan: allocate hot spare -> shift running pods -> mark node cordoned -> kick local swap -> create temporary routing policy to avoid eu-west low capacity.

jess_ops: I'll run the node drain sequence now:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-12
kubectl drain gpu-node-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=30m
```

carl_infra: After drain, handoff to infra tech for physical swap. Nina please confirm courier label once ready and post final manifest here.

nina_hw: Label ready, photos uploaded to ticket and S3: https://s3.redwood.ai/rma/34892/photos.zip

maria_sre: Claimed spare as of 2026-03-15T08:45Z. Autoscaler backfill scheduled.

carl_infra: Closing loop: once vendor confirms pickup, update ticket and I'll schedule invoice reconciliation. Thanks all :thumbsup:

vendorbot: Ticket 34892: Courier pickup scheduled for 2026-03-17 14:00Z. Tracking: TRK-55921.
